title: WCAG 2.2 text-spacing requirements
statement:
WCAG 2.2 requires content to survive user-applied text-spacing changes of at least 1.5× line height, 2× paragraph spacing, 0.12em letter spacing, and 0.16em word spacing, so production interfaces should avoid layouts that break when users substantially loosen text spacing.

Options:
- WCAG threshold: 1.5 / 2 / 0.12em / 0.16em (fits: balanced, professional)
- More airy: 1.6 / 2.2 / 0.14em / 0.18em (fits: comfortable, friendly)
- Reading mode: 1.8 / 2.5 / 0.16em / 0.20em (fits: access-first, calm)
appliesWhen: Applies to: general web, web apps, content sites, education. Audience: adults, children under 10, seniors, general.
